propositions: Monolithic build-and-test job in gerrit-verify.yaml hand-copies gate+suite command set from test.yml, requiring manual sync policing via test_ci_workflow_parity.py; consolidating into a shared _build-and-test.yml reusable workflow eliminates drift by construction.

The reusable _build-and-test.yml must define three separate jobs (lint, pip-audit, test matrix) mirroring test.yml's decomposition, with conditional checkout parameterized by gerrit-refspec like _optionality.yml, taking no secrets.

test.yml must delegate to the reusable via workflow_call while preserving its job-graph parallelism and keeping golden-path + artifact-probe + external (secret-scoped) jobs inline; gerrit-verify.yaml must replace its monolithic build-and-test with a single reusable-call job still named build-and-test, reducing the 4x matrix footprint by running lint/config-check once.

test_ci_workflow_parity.py's five validation functions must be rewritten to assert both test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml delegate to the single _build-and-test.yml reusable file (instead of checking for copy-sync); three safety invariants (script-gate asymmetry, pre-commit SKIP set, optionality contract) must be preserved and retargeted.

actionlint and test_workflow_names.py must validate the reusable workflow's uses-wiring, input schema, and naming (Build and Test (reusable)) without requiring post-merge execution to discover structural errors.

The Verified vote must still need build-and-test and optionality; im-open/workflow-conclusion must fold the reusable's job conclusions into the vote, confirming the refactored path works end-to-end post-merge via test.yml (branch-head lane).
